T: Catch the chicken. Then cook it.
D: Rocky marries Adrian and trains for a rematch with the champion.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky finally catches the chicken.
S: Rocky's shift at the meat packing plant
Thick slices of pork roll fried until the edges curl, stacked on soft rolls with fried egg and cheese.
Wedding day devilled eggs with crisp ham

Eggs boiled and halved, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a dash of hot sauce, piped back and topped with crisp fried ham, paprika and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of hot sauce, salt and pepper until smooth. Dice 100g leg ham finely and fry in a dry pan until crisp. Pipe the yolk mix back into the whites, top with the crisp ham, a dusting of paprika and chopped chives.
Prosciutto folded with cubes of provolone, olives and strips of roasted capsicum on toothpicks, with crusty bread and olive oil.
M: the chicken chasing training, Mickey's idea

Whole chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with garlic, lemon, rosemary and paprika, roasted until the skin is crisp, with potatoes roasted in the drippings. Cut the backbone out of a 1.8kg chicken and press it flat. Rub with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the zest and juice of a lemon, chopped rosemary, 2 tsp paprika, olive oil and salt. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and salt in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes, then carve.
home cooking in the new house
Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
W: Ricotta drained and beaten with icing sugar, orange zest and chopped dark chocolate, piped into crisp shells, ends dipped in pistachio.
K: the morning run with half of Philadelphia behind him
A ripe banana, cold milk, oats, a spoon of peanut butter and honey blended thick. Skip the raw eggs.

s.note: Rocky's shift at the meat packing plant
s.how: Cut 400g pork roll or thick ham into 8 slices, nick the edges and fry 2 minutes a side until they curl and brown. Fry 4 eggs. Stack the pork, eggs and 4 slices American cheese into 4 soft rolls and wrap in foil for 2 minutes to melt.

Cut 150g provolone into cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with folded prosciutto, an olive and a strip of roasted red capsicum. Pile onto a board with sliced Italian bread and a small bowl of olive oil for dipping, like a stall at the market.

m.note: home cooking in the new house
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, a cup of breadcrumbs, grated parmesan, parsley and an egg. Roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer for 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti with extra parmesan.

w.how: Drain 500g ricotta overnight, then beat with 80g icing sugar, orange zest and 50g finely chopped dark chocolate. Spoon into a piping bag and fill 12 cannoli shells just before serving so they stay crisp. Dip each end in chopped pistachios.

d.note: the morning run with half of Philadelphia behind him
d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas with 750ml cold milk, 4 tbsp rolled oats, a big spoon of peanut butter and a drizzle of honey until thick and smooth. Pour into tall glasses. Skip the raw eggs, your training will go just fine without them.
